It has also been given orally to enhance delineation of the bowel during magnetic resonance imaging. Other perfluorocarbons have also been used. A mixture of perfl- uamine (perfluorotripropylamine) and perflunafene (p.2365) has been used to prevent myocardial ischaemia during percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty. Perfluorocarbons such as perflunafene and perfluorooctane (p.2365) have been used in eye surgery. Blood substitutes.
